DESCRIPTION
Situated within York’s historic city walls and forming part of a highly sought after development, this beautifully presented second floor apartment offers stylish and contemporary living in an exceptional city centre location.

Finished to a high standard throughout, the property features a bright and spacious open plan living area with modern fitted kitchen, a generous double bedroom, and a sleek, contemporary bathroom. The apartment is thoughtfully designed to maximise both comfort and practicality, making it ideal for first-time buyers, professionals, investors, or those seeking a city pied-à-terre.

A particular highlight of the property is the private balcony, providing an attractive outdoor space to relax and enjoy the surroundings.

Perfectly positioned for easy access to York’s extensive range of shops, restaurants, cafés and transport links, this fantastic apartment combines modern living with the convenience and character of one of the city's most desirable locations.
